subject: Post-discovery: Infra fit + architecture slot for Brightline
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@brightline.io>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + next step — infra fit for Redwood at Brightline

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for the time on the discovery call earlier. Quick summary: Brightline is looking to validate inference performance and integration patterns (VPC peering, audit logs, retention policy) before we pilot. Hannah (cc) is our pre-sales engineer and will run a short architecture session to show how Redwood maps to your network and compliance needs.

Proposed scope for the session (attached agenda):
- 25m architecture walkthrough (network, routing, model variants)
- 20m deployment patterns + data flow (VPC/private options)
- 15m Q&A and next steps / MAP

Can you share 2–3 60-minute slots next week that work for you and Elena? I attached a brief agenda (post_discovery_agenda.pdf).

Attendees from our side: Aditya (AE), Hannah (Pre-sales), Laura (Solutions Eng). Marcus (runtime lead) may join if we detach into kernel/quant questions.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

Attachments: post_discovery_agenda.pdf
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@brightline.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@brightline.io>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + next step — infra fit for Redwood at Brightline

Thanks Aditya — this looks good. Elena and I are generally available next week in the mornings (US ET). Proposed slots:
- Tue 2026-11-02 09:00–10:00 ET
- Wed 2026-11-03 10:30–11:30 ET
- Fri 2026-11-05 08:30–09:30 ET

A couple of quick asks so Hannah can tailor the session:
1) Can you confirm whether the session will include a quick demo of KV/prefix caching behavior under steady-state throughput?
2) We need to loop in our security engineer (Elena) — she'll want to validate audit log retention and where logs live (Redwood control plane vs customer VPC).

If you can confirm the first two items and block Tue 11/02 09:00 ET that would be ideal.

—Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of Platform, Brightline Health
sanjay@brightline.io
From: hannah_schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + next step — infra fit for Redwood at Brightline

Hi Sanjay / Elena —

Thanks for the slots and the questions — yes, we will cover KV/prefix caching behavior. Marcus (cc) will present the throughput/steady-state notes and run a short demo that shows how prefix caching reduces per-token compute at different QPS profiles.

Agenda (final):
- 10m introductions & success criteria (Aditya / Brightline)
- 25m architecture walkthrough (VPC peering, routing, private control plane) — Hannah + Laura
- 15m runtime demo (KV cache + batching behavior) — Marcus
- 10m security & logs (where logs live, retention, KMS integration) — Laura
- 10m Q&A & next steps / MAP

We can do Tue 2026-11-02 09:00–10:00 ET — provisional calendar link below. Please confirm and I will send a calendar invite with dial-in + recordings enabled.

Provisional meeting (add to your calendar): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-brightline-20261102
Shared prep doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3Cpost_discovery_map

Attachments: redwood-infra-demo-deck.pptx

Best,
Hannah Schmitt

From: Elena Morales <elena@brightline.io>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@brightline.io>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + next step — infra fit for Redwood at Brightline

Thanks Hannah — Tue 11/02 09:00 ET works for me. A couple of clarifications on logs/security so Marcus/Laura can prep:
- We need to confirm whether audit logs for inference requests can be sent to our Splunk instance via a push or S3 export. If export is only via Redwood control plane, we'll need details about log residency and encryption (KMS).
- Also please include the expected retention window for control-plane logs and where we can configure retention for audit exports.

I'll be on the call and might drop in our infra lead if needed. See you Tuesday.

—Elena
Elena Morales
Security Engineer, Brightline Health
elena@brightline.io

Subject: Confirmed: Brightline — infra fit review (11/02 09:00 ET)

All — confirmed for Tue 2026-11-02 09:00–10:00 ET. Calendar invite has been sent from our side and includes the video bridge + dial-in. Agenda and demo deck are attached again for convenience.

Quick prep notes for Brightline security:
- We will show an example flow exporting audit logs to an S3 bucket (can be configured to push to your Splunk via our export runner) and will outline KMS key ownership options (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed).
- Default control-plane retention is 90 days; we will review how to set up exports for longer-term archival and the compliance review path.
